title: Commented-out calculation
description:
Error-prone rule — a calculation slot whose entire formula is one comment block. Field calculations, auto-enter and validation formulas, custom functions and script-step calculations are all covered. The formula never evaluates, so the intended behavior is silently disabled while the slot still looks occupied in the FileMaker dialogs.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Broken Calculation /*Commented Out*/" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A formula wrapped entirely in a comment evaluates to nothing. Whatever the slot was meant to compute stays switched off, and nothing in the interface hints at it — the field still shows a calculation, the step still shows a formula.
rule.remediation: Restore the formula or clear the slot entirely — an empty slot states the intent, a commented-out one hides it.
